description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [ATK and MAG -15%, DEF -70% (25s)], grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [High Quick Cast 3] to all allies, grants [Awoken Way of the Qu] and [Purveyor of Taste Mode] to the user

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Awoken Way of the Qu
description.text: Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/x2.25/x2.50/x2.75/x3.00 for Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, restores 1000 HP to all allies after using Support abilities

description.name: Purveyor of Taste Mode
description.text: Causes [Conditional Imperil 10% (15s)] when another ally uses an ability that deals Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark or Poison damage, removed after triggering three times
